question: Should Discord `slashCommandDeploy` default to `changed-only` for existing installations once the migration is upgrade-safe?
rationale: This PR adds a public config key and changes default startup reconciliation behavior; automation can repair the migration bug, but it cannot choose the long-term Discord deploy policy for operators.

options.title: Approve Changed-Only Default
options.body: Keep `changed-only` as the default after the migration preserves shipped cache behavior and docs explain `always` for forced reconcile.

options.title: Make Changed-Only Opt-In
options.body: Keep prior per-restart reconcile as the default and require operators to set `slashCommandDeploy: "changed-only"`.

options.title: Reject The New Surface
options.body: Keep the existing hash cache mitigation and close this PR in favor of a narrower Discord deploy-control design.

recommendation.title: Approve Changed-Only Default
recommendation.body: Keep `changed-only` as the default after the migration preserves shipped cache behavior and docs explain `always` for forced reconcile.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent authored the shipped deploy-hash cache that this PR migrates and is a strong routing candidate for the default/upgrade decision.
